# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.2.1

This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## Changed

- **Custom modes take you back to their list.** When a custom run ends, Continue goes back to the Custom modes list instead of the Single Player screen, with the mode you just played highlighted, so another go is one press. Master Deadline and Master Evolved still go back to their own page.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.2.1-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
